title: Evaluation of an output circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a multi-output Boolean circuit, let $i$ be an index less than the number of its designated output vertices, and let $x$ be an input. The evaluation of the single-output circuit selecting the $i$th designated output of $C$ equals the $i$th entry of the evaluation list of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is less than the number of designated output vertices
$x$ is an input to the circuit
